programs.title: Cape Carnage: Killer Catch
programs.desc: In their final week, the Wildcard crew are 2.1 tonnes short of their 45-tonne goal. At Cape Carnage, with sharks circling, they fight for their last chance at a killer catch.

programs.title: Outback Truckers
programs.desc: In the wilds of Australia’s Northern Territory, 24-year-old trucker Boe Vella crosses croc infested rivers to deliver desperately needed goods before the wet season hits.

programs.title: Train Rescue Down Under
programs.desc: The Ghan's maintenance team must race to ensure the train departs the next day, and a routine job on a Queensland Rail commuter train hits a snag.

programs.title: Deadliest Roads
programs.desc: Trucker Hugh Rowland takes on an old donkey trail with some dynamite during his nearly impossible climb into the Andes.

programs.title: Storage Wars
programs.desc: The buyers head to Torrance, where Dave sees his profits grow - amongst other things. Mary finds clothes that don't fit her, which turns out to be a good thing. And Kenny takes a chance at being an early bird, but winds up looking more like a dodo.

programs.title: American Pickers
programs.desc: The guys are freestyling in Kansas with an empty van when they stumble upon a staggering honey hole. Meanwhile, in Iowa, Danielle learns that Frank's coin-op motorbike is worth some serious coin.
